# eSIM.dog: full product and price catalogue

> Prepaid travel eSIMs with fixed data allowances, daily high-speed allowances, configurable unlimited plans and regional coverage.

Price snapshot: 2026-11-12. Currency: USD. Each price is for the complete stated package or billing period. Tax may be added at checkout as shown on the product page.

## Products and help
- Country plans: fixed data, or a selectable number of days for unlimited plans. https://esim.dog/
- Regional plans: packages covering several countries. Coverage is listed with each group below. https://esim.dog/regions
- WorldPass: global data subscription. https://esim.dog/worldpass

## Reading the catalogue

Fixed price tables keep all variants for the same destination, data allowance and duration together, sorted by total USD. Read the exact duration row before selecting a price. Equal minimum prices remain separate variants.
The Buy template is directly above each country fixed price table. Set {data_parameter} to data= from its heading (or an option-specific override), {days} to the selected row and {route} to the colour of that option: Yellow1 means yellow, Black2 means black, AmberEssential1 means amber. Other variants use their colour in lowercase. Each country's variant-conditions table gives a separate row for each option. A network listed for Black1 belongs only to Black1; 'See product page' supplies no network name for that option.
In the Service column, Full speed; hotspot means full-speed data with hotspot supported. Each unlimited block contains one plan, its networks, its Buy link and its complete price table. A row 81-90 contains the total USD prices for 81,82,83,84,85,86,87,88,89,90 days, in that order. For example, the third number is the full price for 83 days. Substitute that duration into the same block's Buy link. These are full-package prices, not daily rates.
Purple fully unlimited plans have no daily quota. Other unlimited plans give a daily high-speed allowance which resets each day, followed by unlimited data at the stated speed.
For regional fixed plans use the exact data and duration heading, the selected option's plan= value, and that block's Buy template. Retain each option's own coverage. Regional unlimited tables use the same day ranges and ordered total prices as country unlimited tables.
Blue, Black, Green, Yellow and Pink identify options displayed on eSIM.dog. Amber Essential fixed plans have a 1 Mbps speed cap and no hotspot. Fixed-plan links select the eSIM without a VPN add-on. Include the selected variant's completed purchase link in recommendations.
